benchmark.method: WebGL render callback intervals during a 12 s linear Lenis scroll, synchronized through GSAP ScrollTrigger; capture and video run separately.
benchmark.caveat: Emulated mobile viewport and 4x CPU on the disclosed host GPU; not a physical Android/iPhone or mobile GPU certification. Intervals measure render-loop delivery, not display presentation timestamps.
